modmenu.summaryTranslation.dynamicrpghud: A cleaner, cinematic RPG-style HUD that fades away when you do not need it.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.dynamicrp: Hides your hotbar and status bars with a smooth animation and brings them back when something happens. Choose the hide delay and the events that show the HUD in Automatic Mode, and move, scale and hide the HUD of Jade, WTHIT, Xaero's Minimap, Sodium Extra, FPS - Display, Simple Voice Chat, MiniHUD and Overflowing Bars. Want another mod supported? Discord: https://discord.gg/7qzAw5Cckx
dynamicrpghud.confirm.everything.title: Reset Everything?
dynamicrpghud.confirm.everything.message: This restores the animation, trigger and the position, scale and visibility of every element to their defaults. This cannot be undone.
dynamicrpghud.confirm.positions.title: Reset All Positions?
dynamicrpghud.confirm.positions.message: Every element goes back to its vanilla position and size. This cannot be undone.
